title: MandateShield Conformance Profile v1
disclaimer: Passing these vectors shows behavior against this published vendor profile only. It is not certification, an independent security audit, or proof that any deployment is correctly configured or operated.

token_semantics.{{NOW}}: Materialize as the runner's current ISO 8601 timestamp.
token_semantics.{{NOW+300S}}: Materialize as an ISO 8601 timestamp exactly 300 seconds after the runner's current time.

runner_classes.offline-policy: Runs locally without credentials against deterministic envelope policy checks.
runner_classes.strict-api-sequence: Requires an isolated live or staging account because durable replay state is part of the assertion.
runner_classes.cryptographic-integration: Requires the implementer to generate test-only keys and signatures from the fixture instructions.
runner_classes.receipt-integration: Requires a test-only receipt signing key; never reuse a production signing key.
runner_classes.execution-evidence-integration: Requires test-only execution keys and an isolated durable store to verify strict token types, exact audience binding, atomic one-use redemption and terminal evidence semantics.

vectors.title: Exact USD minor-unit agreement
vectors.description: The major-unit and integer minor-unit representations agree exactly and remain below the registered cap.

vectors.title: Conflicting fiat representations
vectors.description: A large major-unit value cannot be made harmless by attaching a contradictory one-cent minor-unit value.

vectors.title: Fractional zero-decimal currency
vectors.description: JPY has a zero-decimal executable exponent; a fractional major-unit amount must not be rounded silently.

vectors.title: Exact atomic amount beyond Number precision
vectors.description: A canonical decimal string at the exact cap remains executable even when JavaScript Number cannot preserve the integer.

envelope.purpose: Purchase one exact paid API resource

vectors.title: One atomic unit over the cap
vectors.description: The requested integer differs by one at a precision where floating-point conversion loses the distinction.

envelope.purpose: Purchase one exact paid API resource

vectors.title: Paid-resource substitution
vectors.description: Changing only the paid resource changes the authorized purchase and must fail closed.

envelope.purpose: Purchase one exact paid API resource

vectors.title: Unknown strict constraint
vectors.description: Strict production must reject a constraint it cannot evaluate instead of returning approval while ignoring it.

vectors.title: Unsafe payment-attempt identifier
vectors.description: A replay identifier with whitespace is not a canonical attempt key and cannot enter the strict boundary.

vectors.title: Account-wide consume-once attempt
vectors.description: A live harness reuses one signed attempt across retries, key rotation and a changed envelope to prove that payment intent is consumed account-wide.
preconditions: One active registered mandate and pinned issuer key
One fresh signed challenge for the exact envelope
Two live API keys belonging to the same account

sequence.mutation: Submit the original request with API key A.
Retry the identical request with the same account and idempotency key.

expected.behavior: recover the exact previously committed response

sequence.mutation: Change the envelope but retain the idempotency key; optionally rotate to API key B.

vectors.title: JWS final-envelope substitution
vectors.description: A valid JWS over another canonical purchase digest must not authorize the evaluated envelope.

vectors.title: AP2 holder proof omitted
vectors.description: The closed-payment AP2 projection requires an issuer-bound SD-JWT disclosure and RFC 9901 key-binding JWT.

mutation.operation: remove key-binding JWT from SD-JWT+KB presentation

vectors.title: TAP signed component omitted
vectors.description: The normalized TAP projection must sign method, authority, path and the exact content digest.

vectors.title: Receipt decision-core tampering
vectors.description: Even a newly signed fixture is invalid when decision_core changes without recomputing its bound digest.

vectors.title: Receipt binding contradiction
vectors.description: A self-consistent core digest still fails if top-level decision or execution state contradicts the signed core.

expected.verifier_error_contains: top-level decision bindings do not match the decision core

vectors.title: Execution-permit token-type substitution
vectors.description: A signature from the execution key does not make a decision receipt or terminal receipt usable as an execution permit.

vectors.title: Execution-permit audience ambiguity
vectors.description: The execution audience is one exact string; an array cannot broaden or ambiguate the facilitator boundary.

vectors.title: Atomic fresh permit-claim race
vectors.description: Concurrent facilitator claims for one signed permit must produce exactly one fresh provider-submission authorization.

mutation.operation: race every redemption against the same durable permit row

vectors.title: Terminal receipt permit-binding substitution
vectors.description: A terminal execution receipt cannot be detached from the exact claimed permit and rebound to another execution attempt.

mutation.operation: replace without replacing the bound permit_hash

vectors.title: Caller evidence cannot become provider evidence
vectors.description: An authenticated PROCESSOR-key outcome remains caller-asserted unless stronger configured provider or chain evidence is checked without trusting the caller report.
